title: statusmodel.runCompleted reads any run_finished line as completion, including a failed incarnation's
description:
runCompleted (internal/statusmodel/build.go) scans the whole feed for ANY run_finished line, so a resumed run whose first incarnation ended failed reads as completed for the WaitMerge wait; only m.CI being nil in most checkouts hides it. A failed-then-resumed epic with an open PR could surface a merge wait (and, through the watch's now model-based exit, a held 3) for a run that is not completed. Discovered while unifying the watch's exit code on the model in 4mv; not changed there because CI==nil guards it today.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding 9fa185037c664d84b7f062d6853d34424aec0c08e090a5953118f018dc345407 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-4mv/attempt-33): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A4. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/9fa185037c664d84b7f062d6853d34424aec0c08e090a5953118f018dc345407.json on the run branch.
